anticipated.tagline: He's in for the royal treatment.

anticipated.title: The Croods: A New Age

As tensions between the new neighbors start to rise, a new threat soon propels both clans on an epic adventure that forces them to embrace their differences, draw strength from one another, and survive together.
anticipated.tagline: The future ain't what it used to be.

anticipated.title: Saving Private Ryan

anticipated.tagline: The greatest fairy tale never told.

anticipated.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
